status: Candidate representative assignments; visual acceptance pending
source_scope: 36 spring-neutral NPC entries (34 distinct sampled ramps), plus36 creator ramps. Source colors do not exhaust lighting, cosmetics or intermediate material shades.
method: D65 sRGB to CIELAB; mean deltaE76 between four ordered shade roles weighted .35,.35,.2,.1. Three/five-sample source ramps are evenly resampled in Lab for ranking only, without authoring new donor colors. Each NPC includes its own Vanilla sampled ramp and only its actual selectable donor IDs. This is a nearest-reference diagnostic, with no acceptance threshold or coverage percentage.
